notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.9.4.0.0
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/e6eb4854c1393c4b67ae74e2bc88e5ebb50eca55.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj"]You can join Discord server here.[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Shades of Rayna Update 0.9.4.0.0[/p][p][/p][p][b]Achievements[/b][/p][p]Steam achievements can be earned now.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Hardcore[/b][/p][p]You can create Hardcore characters now. These characters will be removed upon death. Hardcore leaderboards are seperate from regular leaderboards.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Haunted Grounds[/b][/p][p]New mode is added to Rift Gate. It's a game mode that has 4 haunted spawners which spawn pumpkin enemies based on your damage. Defeated pumpkins will drop tokens. You can use these tokens to get rewards at the shop after all 4 spawners are defeated.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Labyrinth Enhancers[/b][/p][p]You can now unlock enhancers on labyrinth unlocks. At the start of labyrinth runs, you can amplify the run by selecting mods, which have both a good stat and a bad stat. You can unlock enhancers up to 5.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tempered and Uber Bosses[/b][/p][p]Tempered and Uber keystones are added to the game. Champion bosses have tempered versions, Doombringer and Witch have Uber versions. There are also new conquer objectives for tempered and uber bosses. Tempered is difficulty 150, Uber is 200.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Game Modes[/b][/p][p]-Returning to base from a conquer map will now set that node as failed in the layout.[/p][p]-Custom Keystones now have regular conquer nodes.[/p][p]-Mayhem Keystone layouts are now created with 5 default map mods. You can change with your selected ones.[/p][p]-Labyrinth starting node count is now 5.[/p][p]-Improved Shielder, Energy, Triforce and Allower mode in Labyrinth.[/p][p]-Increased Allower's radius in Labyrinth.[/p][p]-Increased the points Allower, Energy and Triforce give.[/p][p]-Underworld Modifiers will be given at default after the base difficulty is 30.[/p][p]-Adjusted some of the lab tasks and their rewards.[/p][p]-Dark Lands doesn't have orbs as rewards anymore.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Ranger[/b][/p][p]-'Speed Up' passive, which increases basic arrow speed, has been changed to [b]Windrush[/b] :[/p][p]"[i]Every time you hit enemies, you stack Windrush, which increases your movement speed by 1% (Max: 15%). You lose 5 stacks when you get hit"[/i][/p][p][i]-[/i]'Another One' passive, which lets you shoot 2 basic attack arrows, has been changed to [b]Evasion[/b] :[/p][p]"[i]Every kill gives 2% chance to evade attacks, up to 70%. You lose 20% chance if you get hit"[/i][/p][p][i]-[/i]'Fly Through' passive, which makes basic attack arrows pierce, has been changed to [b]Volley[/b] :[/p][p]"[i]Every damaged enemy fills up Volley bar. When maxed, a volley of arrows get shot in front of you, each pierces one enemy"[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Warrior[/b][/p][p]-'Scatter' passive is not tied to basic attack anymore:[/p][p]"[i]At every 10th kill, with 25% chance, you spread small axe fragments around you[/i]"[/p][p][/p][p][b]Mage[/b][/p][p][i]-[/i]'Boom It' passve, which makes the basic attack deal area damage, has been changed to [b]Echo[/b] :[/p][p]"[i]Your 25th hit to enemies will leave a damage area under the last hit enemy"[/i][/p][p][i]-[/i]'Reduce' passive, which decreases skill cooldowns, has been changed to [b]Orbital[/b] :[/p][p]"[i]At every 10th kill, with 35% chance, rotating orbs spawn around you"[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Assassin[/b][/p][p][b]-[/b]'Twin Strike' passive, now in effect for all skills, not just basic attack :[/p][p]"[i]You will strike twice at your 25th hit[/i]"[/p][p][/p][p][b]Outlaw[/b][/p][p]-'Minade' passive, which leaves mines when you dodge, has been changed. Now it's in effect with all attacks:[/p][p]"[i]At every 25th hit, with 35% chance, a bomb spawns on top of the enemy[/i]"[/p][p]-'Expullet' passive, which makes basic attack bullets explode, has been changed to [b]Deflect[/b] :[/p][p]"[i]Every kill gives 2% chance to deflect attacks with bombs around you, up to 60%. You lose 20% chance with each deflect[/i]"[/p][p]-Increased Deadeye's damage.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Enemies[/b][/p][p]-Enemy mode active times are increased and their cooldowns are decreased.[/p][p]-Increased the chance of enemies having mods.[/p][p]-Balanced enemy health and damage.[/p][p]-Added new attack moves to Doombringer and Witch.[/p][p]-Improved the attack moves of champion bosses.[/p][p]-Status effects don't work on major bosses now. Also don't work on tempered bosses.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][p]-Researcher, Collector, Bounty Hunter and Trader now give extra witch hunt progression. Getting all extras shortens the campaign by 1 map region.[/p][p]-Fixed the problem that mayhem traps spawning in the air.[/p][p]-Increased mayhem trap count by 1 after difficulty 50, 100 and 150.[/p][p]-Increased mayhem trap spawn chance from 50% to 75% after difficulty 100.[/p][p]-You can now use skills while keeping the button pressed down.[/p][p]-Max difficulty is now 200.[/p][p]-Steal passive skill is now in effect for all active skills as well.[/p][p]-Blind and Stun enemy mods are now default modes, instead of only underworld modifiers.[/p][p]-Increased Challenger reward counts.[/p][p]-Decreased Anniversary Shop reward costs.[/p][p]-Decreased Skill Point Shop reward costs.[/p][p]-Materials now drop as stacks, depending on the difficulty. Including research and collector quest materials.[/p][p]-Decrease the area of Status Spreader.[/p][p]-Stun, Blind, Fear immunity and recovery relics combined into one relic and the stats are increased.[/p][p]-Increased the required gold and skill point to unlock passive skills.[/p][p]-Grand Relics now drop as orbs. You can either select 3 stats out of 15 to form your own relic or get a random one from the orbs.[/p][p]-Added 2 new relics: Clasm which makes basic attacks make explosion and Dotta which adds dot's skills' damage to per second damage and makes base damage 0.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Passive Skill Changes
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/9aa9499515b6f624f13177e2dfa01231d3fbe312.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj"]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Some of the passive skills have been changed. They were not affecting the whole gameplay or were not good as some of the other passives.


[b]Ranger[/b]

-'Speed Up' passive, which increases basic arrow speed, has been changed to [b]Windrush[/b] : 
"[i]Every time you hit enemies, you stack Windrush, which increases your movement speed by 1% (Max: 15%). You lose 5 stacks when you get hit"

-[/i]'Another One' passive, which lets you shoot 2 basic attack arrows, has been changed to [b]Evasion[/b] :
"[i]Every kill gives 2% chance to evade attacks, up to 70%. You lose 20% chance if you get hit"

-[/i]'Fly Through' passive, which makes basic attack arrows pierce, has been changed to [b]Volley[/b] :
"[i]Every damaged enemy fills up Volley bar. When maxed, a volley of arrows get shot in front of you, each pierces one enemy"

[/i][b]Mage[/b][i]

-[/i]'Boom It' passve, which makes the basic attack deal area damage, has been changed to [b]Echo[/b] :
"[i]Your 25th hit to enemies will leave a damage area under the last hit enemy"

-[/i]'Reduce' passive, which decreases skill cooldowns, has been changed to [b]Orbital[/b] :
"[i]At every 10th kill, with 35% chance, rotating orbs spawn around you"

[/i][b]Assassin

-[/b]'Twin Strike' passive, now in effect for all skills, not just basic attack :
"[i]You will strike twice at your 25th hit[/i]"

[b]Warrior

[/b]-'Scatter' passive is not tied to basic attack anymore: 
"[i]At every 10th kill, with 25% chance, you spread small axe fragments around you[/i]"

[b]Outlaw

[/b]-'Minade' passive, which leaves mines when you dodge, has been changed. Now it's in effect with all attacks:
"[i]At every 25th hit, with 35% chance, a bomb spawns on top of the enemy[/i]"

-'Expullet' passive, which makes basic attack bullets explode, has been changed to [b]Deflect[/b] :
"[i]Every kill gives 2% chance to deflect attacks with bombs around you, up to 60%. You lose 20% chance with each deflect[/i]"[/p]

notes.title: Grand Relic Stat Selecting
notes.content:

You can build a relic as you want by selecting a random stat from each category (attack-defence-skill).

You can also get a totally random relic like before. The pool of stats in stat selecting will be refreshed after each craft or random relic.

Grand Relic crafting will also give Grand Relic Orbs.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.9.3.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/2e915a24f907028e8dd9e523cb005b80cefff55e.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Shades of Rayna Update 0.9.3.0.0


[b]Shade Realm - Ruler Items[/b]
New endgame game mode has been added to rift gate. You can enter the Shade Realm with its rift stone when your base's difficulty level is 150+.

Shade Cache Carriers in Shade Realm drop materials to craft Ruler items which is the highest tier in the game. 

In Shade Realm, you kill enemies to drop special items which decrease your damage to Shade Cache Carriers. More you hit them, more items they drop. So, if your damage to them is lowest, you get more items from them. Make sure to collect all damage reducers before you face the Carriers.


[b]Endgame Prestige Tree[/b]
Prestige Tree is now in the game. You can alter your endgame farms with the tree. You get 1 prestige point for every level up after level 999.

There are total of 162 prestige points in the tree. You can spend maximum of 100 prestige points.

You need to max out a node to be able to select the node it is connected to.

You can reset the tree at any time and reclaim all the prestige points you spent, without any additional cost.


[b]Npc Keystones - Endgame Target Farm[/b]
All 4 npcs now have their keystone. You can access their farming ground via these keystones. In the farming ground, each npc has different items/materials to get. So you can target farm these keystones depending on your need.

4 new materials are added for each npc. These materials can be used to buy keystones from the rewards section on npc talk screen. The new materials drop from npc portal activities and any reward that's called "Npc Loot".


[b]Game[/b]
-You can now reset your attributes and get the materials you had spent on them.
-Some attributes have increased values now. The increment value of the attibutes will be increased every 25 levels.
-Added auto-attack system.
-Significantly changed various relic values or how they work.
-Decreased total conquer objective count from 107 to 44.
-Added difficulty selection to Boss Rush.
-It's now quicker to get levels.
-Increased the percentage of life steal for Ranger, Outlaw and Lasher.
-Selected map mods now affect the whole layout. You can still change before any node.
-Count selection is added to Craft and Salvager.
-Custom Keystones don't have 25 slots anymore.
-Collector Portal Activity is now changed, it's not the same with Researcher Portal Activity anymore.
-Target Board now moves slowly after difficulty 10.
-Mayhem traps now spawn on all levels after level 20, except Labyrinth.
-Added ui icon to boss tracks, so they can be seen more easily.
-Increased Blastice damage by x2 and it's area by 1.5x.
-Increased Growing Taint by 4x and it's area by 2x.
-Increased Doomar duration by 2.5x.
-Increased Boloom damage and area.
-Increased Shine and Shade damage, area and duration.


[b]Loot[/b]
-Decreased the loot count from chests from 20 to 14.
-Bounties now drop more loot.
-You can now get grand items from t10 item exchange.
-Drop info is added to items in Collection.
-Pet drops are now called as Pet Shards. You can upgrade any pet with 5 shards.
-Added multiple new relics for better game experience for early-mid game.
-New unique t10 items are added for Assassin, Outlaw and Mage.


[b]Enemies[/b]
-Difficulty effect on boss, elite and veteran enemy spawns are now more.
-Increased the health, defence and size of map bosses.
-Enemy resistances are now higher than enemy defence.

.(%) Shade Damage for every equipped Angelic item %
.(%) Gloom Damage for every equipped Angelic item %
.(%) Void Damage for every equipped Angelic item %
.(%) Doom Damage for every equipped Angelic item %

.(%) Shade Resistance for every equipped Angelic item %

[b]ENEMIES[/b]
-Increased the shield of shielded enemies.
-Increased the damage of shielded enemies.

[b]WORLD[/b]
-Increasing base difficulty is not automatic now. You can increase it at map summary screen in exchange of gold when the map dificulty is higher than the base difficulty.
-Fixed grand upgrade stone drops from Melder.
-Increased the effect of map mods significantly. Thus, decreased the drop chance of map mods.
-Fixed the broken map mod stats.
-Item chunk rewards from Dark Lands now increase with the difficulty. This increase starts after difficulty 10.
-Increased the reward costs of Dark Lands significantly.

-Increased the damage increase of skills from attribute upgrades significantly.
-Skills that have count increase on attribute upgrades, now have 10% less damage per count (Cutter, Blast, Throw, Burning Ball, Inferno, Aqublast)
-Last count upgrade for the skills that have count increase on attribute upgrades is now on level 50, instead of 40.
-You now lose 20% of your experience when you die.
-Conquer Objectives are now shared between seasonal characters.
-Status effects now do their respected element's damage, instead of main attack damage.
-Steal passive now works with a chance, it's not 100% anymore.
-Per Second damages do not get extra damage from the main damage stat anymore.
-Adjusted tier 4 and 9 applier relic chances for all skills.

-Barrage now pierces through enemies. Barrage Wall doesn't.

Shades of Rayna Update 0.9.1.0

Loadouts are disabled during this season event.
Grand Relic salvage is disabled until the fix.


Dark Lands
-New endgame mode where you use a lantern to illuminate your surroundings and you use the power within that lantern to activate various activities to earn Item Chunks.
-Item Chunks are used in the base to get various rewards.
-Item Chunks are also used to improve your lantern and some parts of Dark Lands map.
-There 4 unique bosses which only spawn on Dark Lands.
-New pursue quest is added to unlock Dark Lands.

Season Event Pass
-There is a new event pass for this season with cosmetic rewards.
-Decreased the requirement counts for some of the pass objectives.
-Event pass is only available for seasonal characters.
-Main season leaderboards is Chunks leaderboards.

General
-3 Outskirts mobs are changed visually, because they were causing stuttering on the map while spawning. That is fixed.
-Event Pass requirement counts are decreased significantly for more than half of the challenges.
-Status chancers' damage was physical damage. They now deal their respective element's damage.
-On regular maps, enemies don't spawn at the back anymore.
-Decreased High Stakes spawn rate from 15% to 8%.
-Decreased Anniversary Event spawn rate from 15% to 10%.
-Decreased Gambit shop spawn rate from 10% to 8%.
-Increased the enemy count on portal activities.
-Significantly increased the cooldown reduction on skill attribute upgrade.
-Skills with active duration (Spread, Cutter, Rage, Condemn) now have their time added on their cooldown. So, in other words, their cooldown would not start until their time is off.
-Increased Buy/Sell default renew time.
-Decreased gold and crystal requirement count on gear and relic crafting.

Enemies
-Increased the elemental resist of enemies.
-Significantly decreased the increase on enemy defence per difficulty.

Conquer
-Decreased the chance for conquer nodes to be 1 difficulty higher from 20% to 5%.
-Conquer objectives now register on greater difficulties too.
-Decreased the requirement counts of some of the objectives.
-Decreased the spawn rate of special nodes.

Underworld
-Decrease the length of Underworld maps.

Loot
-Decreased the drop rate of gear and relics.
-Increased the drop rate of Underworld Modifier Token, Buy/Sell Renew Token, Valuables and Craft Materials.
-Decreased the drop rate of Legend items and Grand items except Obsidian.
-Increased the drop rate of Tier 10 items.
-Tier 10 set items can now drop on and after difficulty 4 (it was 6 before).
-Decreased the chance of enemies drop loot from 12% to 8%.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.9 - Depths Season Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/e6eb4854c1393c4b67ae74e2bc88e5ebb50eca55.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Shades of Rayna Update 0.9.0.0

[b]Depths Season Event[/b]
The new event is Depths Season Event. Its main focus is the new location: Depths of Mayhem.
The event has an event pass and 24 challenges. There is no cosmetic reward with this event.
Main leaderboard of the event is total gold looted. Who loots the more gold will win the season at the end of it on 13th of October.

[b]Ultimate Balance Overhaul[/b]
-Enemy damage, defence, health values are readjusted. The jump on enemy stats with each level is now decreased. The progression will feel much better.
-Skills now get more damage from main damage stat. That's why skill damages and cooldowns are readjusted. Also main damage stat of some classes.
-Radial damages are overhauled. Sometimes the radial damage didn't hit all enemies in the area. It's working correctly now.
-All skill areas are increased.
-T4, T7 Basic Applier relics are now combined into a single relic called "Basic Elemental Applier".
-T4, T7 Status Inflict relics are now combined into a single relic called: "Elemental Status Chancer".
-T2, T5, T8 Res Boost relics are now combined into a single relic called: "Elemental Resistance Boost".
-T2, T5, T8 Damage type relics are now combined into a single relic called: "Elemental Damage Boost".
-T8 elemental resist relics now give +12, instead of +8.
-T10 elemental damage relics now give +30, instead of +20.
-T10 elemental resist relics now give +30, instead of 10.
-T10 Trinity resistance relic now gives +16 each, instead of +8.
-T10 elemental damage booster relics are now combined into a single relic called "Basic Elemental Applier Booster I-II".
-T4, T9 Skill Damage Type Applier relics are now combined into a single relic which applies all damage types to that skill.
-T4 skill damage type applier relic chance is now 20% instead of 45%.
-T9 skill damage type applier relic chance is now 40% instead of 75%.
-T1, T2, T3 skill damage and cooldown relics are combined into relics called: "Skill Damage Boost" and "Skill Cooldown Boost".
-Decreased the cost of passive skills.
-Active skills now all cost the same but the cost increases after each active skill acquisition.
-DoT skill damages are reworked. They are more effective now.
-Cooldown decrease relics are added. Skill cooldowns are increased now but there are cooldown decrease relics which will decrease the cooldown while playing with different actions.

[b]Legend Items / Depths of Mayhem[/b]
-The tier after exalted items are added. Legend items can be dropped after and on difficulty 100. Each legend items has 10 levels. Positive stats increase, negative stats decrease with each level.
-You can level up legend items on Depths of Mayhem. When you kill the Depths boss, Doombringer, it drops the anvil for you upgrade legend items.
-At every level up, the level up succession chance drops. If you fail to upgrade a legend item, it's level drops to 1.
-There are materials which you can prevent this level drop or increase the succession chance. These materials drop on and after difficulty 100.
-You can enter Depths of Mayhem via Rift Gate with Depths Rift Stone.
-Depths of Mayhem is fixed difficulty 100 but the boss Doombringer has increased chance to drop Legend items and materials.

[b][u]Legend upgrading is not in the game yet. You can save the rift stones until it's added.[/u][/b]

[b]Loadouts[/b]
-Loadout system is added. You can set up 5 loadouts and easily equip them on gear screen.

[b]Other Changes[/b]
-Ranger's basic arrow damage gets halved after every pierce.
-Conquer Objectives now give completion rewards.
-The effect of pets are increased.
-Increase the damage of Champion bosses.
-Decrease the attack time of the skills of Champion bosses.
-One skill of each Champion boss deal high damage now.
-Dragons have increased health like Champion Bosses now.
-Added keyboard buttons to screen buttons, such as gear, inventory etc.
-Increased the crystal requirement of all crafts.
-Increased the reward count on Craft Materials node on Conquer layouts from 30 to 60.
-Decreased the reward count on Map Mods node on Conquer layouts from 30 to 15.
-Decreased the reward count on Maps node on Conquer layouts from 30 to 10.
-Decreased the reward count on Random Gear node on Conquer layouts from 30 to 20.
-Decreased the reward count on Random Relic node on Conquer layouts from 30 to 20.
-Increased the experience needed for leveling up after every 100th level.
-New map skill is added: Magnet: When activated, all loot on the ground fly towards you.

notes.title: Introducing Underworld Modifiers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/526cd3e5e618a9c7bc5c0cfb1a93a2196a219f62.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Underworld Modifiers will be added soon. These modifiers will increase the loot rarity, loot quantity and enemy density in addition to some negative stats which will affect your next Underworld run. You can randomize these modifiers with [b]Underworld Modifier Token[/b] which can be obtained like any other loot.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/68e3d8c6f728999e17b795d1ca04d8085f7ca6bd.jpg[/img]


With these modifiers, a new addition to the game can be seen in Underworld: Totems. Currently there are 3 types of totems:

-Regeneration Totems: Regenerates the health of nearby enemies.
-Defence Totems: Increases the defence of nearby enemies.
-Invulnerability Totems: Grants invulnerability to nearby enemies.

Currently, these totems and blind-stun enemy mods can only be seen on modified Underworld runs. There are some other modifiers which can only be seen on Undeworld as well.

Underworld Modifiers will be added to the game with Enemy Mods.

notes.title: Introducing Enemy Mods
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/f79fbedbbbad354a1bc5ca4a885c15a0424d8587.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Enemy modifiers will be added to the game. Veteran, Elite and Boss enemies will have modifiers. 

At difficulty 5, only Boss enemies, at difficulty 10 Elites and at difficulty 20 Veteran enemies start to have mods.

At certain difficulties the mod count increases. After difficulty 60, some enemies might have 7 mods on them. 

Enemies have 33% chance to have a mod. This value can be increased with the new Underworld modifiers. Map bosses have 100% chance to have mods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/c01e86ff292a1e9ffb25f890ea52de1564999db8.png[/img]

You can view the mods that the enemy has, under their healthbar.

Every mod needs to be active in order to be in effect. Enemies use them like skills. All mods have cooldown. You can also view their cooldown by hovering over to the mod.

Current Mods are:

-Ravage: Damage gets increased by 50% for 5 seconds (10 second cooldown)
-Blitz: Attack Speed gets increased by 150% for 5 seconds (10 second cooldown)
-Fortify: Defence gets increased by 150% for 5 seconds (10 second cooldown)
-Vigor: Health gets increased by 15% (10 second cooldown)
-Skirmish: Critic Chance is 100% for 5 seconds (10 second cooldown)
-Fury: Critic Damage gets increased by 50% for 5 seconds (10 second cooldown)
-Blind: Hits blind the character
-Stun: Hits stun the character

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/4a73b142b96cedb87e507fda623735d83b593226.png[/img]

Blind and Stun are new status that will be added to the game with enemy mods.

Blind: You can't attack, use skills or dodge.
Stun: You can't move, attack, use skills or dodge.

Only melee hits can blind or stun.

notes.title: Announcing Booster Flags
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/7b7d1a0937ac8e8e113771d034bd7210049365ea.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Booster Flags is a new addition to the game. When taken, they boost the character for 10 seconds with following stats:

-Damage
-Defence
-Critic Chance
-Critic Damage
-Maximum Health
-Attack Speed
-Movement Speed
-Experience Gain

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/ad8d97bab01799b66b6c245a0d8b714732ef24a5.png[/img]

Booster Flags are dropped by enemies. If an enemy has the booster flag icon above their health bar, they will drop a flag with random stat and random percentage. The boost will last 10 seconds. If a new flag is taken with the same existing stat, it will change the effect percentage and make the time 10 seconds again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/a051a6a6cdb418670507a57e7e5ae2568fc97a6b.png[/img]

Booster Flags will drop more on campaign than endgame. The goal is to speed up the campaign and make it more fun.

Custom Keystones are added to the game. Their difference from regular keystones are that custom keystones do not create a randomized layout. Each custom keystone is dropped with a set of nodes and when you use that keystone, whole layout is made with those nodes.

The difficulty of custom keystones is determined by the difficulty in which they are dropped.

Custom Keystones have 5 tiers:

Standard Keystone: Has 5 nodes

Superior Keystone: Has 3 Nodes

Divine Keystone: Has 1 Node

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/36d19035c45626fd40ec9d2744f8d1e2195cf4ec.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Lasher Open Beta is now available. You can test the new class before the new season.


[b]HOW TO ENTER[/b]

You can enter the beta by following the steps on the images below:

1- Go to Properties of Shades of Rayna on Steam Library

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/171fd818e0dbaeb221d6d1939b32d41dc40349c8.jpg[/img]


2- Go to Betas and select Lasher Test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/38879b16979a654b8014e175d2d62fcf4dcc454a.jpg[/img]


After that, Steam will download the beta version of the game. 

Estimated Size: 12 GB

You need to unselect the beta from the same tab to redownload the regular game.


[b]THE OPEN BETA[/b]

The beta will open with Lasher selected as the class. There is no main menu, you just start at the base. If you don't want to start over the beta or remove your save, you can do it via a button on in-game menu.


[u][i]There shouldn't be any problems regarding the save files but if you have any problems after playing the test, contact me on discord and I'll help you fix it.[/i][/u]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.7.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/e6eb4854c1393c4b67ae74e2bc88e5ebb50eca55.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Shades of Rayna Update 0.7.0.0 (08/10/2023)

[b]New Game Mode: Underworld[/b]
Underworld is a new endgame game mode. It's a procedurally generated dungeon. When you complete it, you unlock the next difficulty and it is endless. With every new difficulty, the dungeon extends.

Underworld has unique portal activities and chest reward system. You get Underworld Tokens from these portal activities or end chests. These tokens are used to unlock those chests after the boss is defeated.

You will be able to unlock it after you complete Conquer Objectives. It has a pursue questline like Challenger's.

[b]New Addition To The Base: Riftgate[/b]
Riftgate is a gateway to other realms. You can use it to travel to Underworld, Haunted Grounds, Depths of Mayhem and Shade Realm. You will need a riftstone to open the portal.

[b]Grand Relics[/b]
Relics now have a tier above tier 10, like gear items. With Grand Relics, trio relic system is changing. These relics don't get seperated as Attack-Defence-Skill, instead a Grand Relic has 3 seperate stats from each and can be equipped on all relic slots.

[b]New Map: Outskirts[/b]
Outskirts is the 10th map of the game and it will be the first map of the campaign when the all 12 maps are added to the game.
Outskirts has 5 unique enemies. Each enemy has unique boss move.
Just like other maps, Outskirts has 2 main and 1 mini layouts.
New Boss: Skenssa
Skenssa is the latest edition of Champion bosses. It's from Shrouded Fields and uses both Fire and Gloom.

[b]Atlis Desert Rework[/b]
Atlis Desert is the 3rd map that have been reworked with all 3 layouts. Enemy spawn and movement are improved on the map with small environment changes.

[b]New Pursue Quests[/b]
Labyrinth and Riftgate have new pursue quests for you. You need to complete these quests to have access to both.

[b]Critic Damage Overhaul[/b]
Critic Damage is not added directly anymore. Instead, the stat is now a multplier and it multiplies the damage applied as critic damage. All stats on items are changed according to this.

[b]Enemies[/b]
-AI behaviour improved.
-Base health value is decreased on Veteran, Elite and Boss enemies but their health now scales more with difficulty.
-Mobs don't follow the player to the end anymore. They have an attack range. If you're out of the range, they stop following.
-Starting animation of enemies is now shorter.

[b]Classes[/b]
-Ranger's Chill, Lightning Strike, Poison Circle skills and Warrior's Slice skill have been reworked.
-Ranger's Rapid Shot skill now has more attack speed than the base attack speed stat and deals area damage.
-Ranger's Chill skill relic Frozen Meteors count is increased.
-Assassin's Throatcut, Deathly Strike and Massacre skills now have larger radius.
-Decrease the attribute upgrade value for critic damage and attack speed.
-Decreased the critic chance, attack speed and critic damage upgrade values on gear slot upgrade.
-Decreased the cooldown decrease of skill upgrading.
-Fixed the problem where Mage's skills did not apply damage types.

[b]Items[/b]
-7 new tier8 relics are added: Fiery Crystals, Blastice, Growing Taint, Doomar, Voidance, Boloom and Shine and Shade. These are "on death" relics. They have an effect when on enemy's death.
-Decreased the critic chance and movement speed values on Tier 10 relics.
-Decreased the attack speed values on the relics above Tier 4.
-Adjusted various stats on grand items. That's why, Grand Items are removed from existing characters and corresponding item orbs are given.
-Adjusted Bombs Away set bonuses.
-Decreased the default Bombs Away chance from 35% to 20%
-Increased Grand Item capacity from 20 to 50.
-Changed the difficulties for Grand Items to drop:
Obsidian: 10+
Ancient: 14+
Mythical: 18+
Angelic: 30+
Exalted: 50+
-Changed the difficulties for Item Orbs to drop:
Obsidian: 9+
Ancient: 13+
Mythical: 17+
Angelic: 28+
Exalted: 45+
Crafting
-Relic Crafting is added.
-T10 Set Item Crafting is added.
-12 new crafting materials are added for Relic crafting.

[b]Game[/b]
-Steps of most Conquer Objectives are reduced. Their required counts are also reduced.
-Removed Mayhem Penalties.
-Mayhem Traps are changed. There are now 1 type trap from each damage types.
-5 new collector materials are added.
-Random Relic, Random Weapon and new 'Random' nodes will now give 15 of that item instead of 10.
-Destructibles now drop tier 1,2,3 gear and crafting materials
-Bounty enemies now have special moves on mayhem+ difficulties.
-Added an option to see heatlh above the player character.
-Added an option to adjust cursor size.
-Added Dps counter on the practice dummies in the base.
-Random Craft Mats, Random Maps and Random Map Mods are added to conquer node pool.
-Trader Nodes and Chest Node won't give lab points anymore.
-Witch spawn is added on Lab Node Pool and Lab Node Upgrades.
-Skenssa is added on Lab Node Pool and Lab Node Upgrades.
-Fixed the problem where Shady Bastard tutorial was showing even though "Skip all tutorials" was selected.

Shades of Rayna Update 0.6.1.0 (24/04/2023)

[b]New Items[/b]
28 new items are added. 14 main weapons and 14 secondary weapons. Half of them are Tier 4 and other half is Tier 8 items. These items boost different damage types and their corresponding attack relics.

Example: Fire Bow (T4): +2 Fire Damage, Boosts T4 Fire Basic Applier Relic's Chance To 60%.

[b]Mayhem Penalties[/b]
Mayhem difficulties now add negative effect to your character. This effect reduces your almost every stats. This effect increases with the difficulty level.

[b]Auto Map Mode Usage[/b]
When you select a map mod stat as favorite, the mods that have that stat will get selected to use. You can change these modes manually after they get selected, if you want.

[b]Closed Node Fill[/b]
You can now fill the closed nodes in a layout with lootable nodes. When you select a closed node, selectable nodes will appear on conquer page. Currently, you can only get these nodes from Challenger Rewards.

[b]Changes[/b]
-Character damage types now scale with Attack Damage.
-Character resistants now scale with Defence.
-Increased almost every special skill relics' damage.
-Increased the damage of all enemy projectiles.
-Adjusted the difficulty effect after Diff 10.
-Adjusted damage output of enemies on different damage types.
-Adjusted skill damages to corresponding damage types.
-Increased damage type status damages.
-Increased the veteran, elite and boss damage.
-Greatly increased the spawned enemy count from challenge flag in labyrinth.
-Increased the spawned enemy count from challenge flag in conquer mode.
-Grand Upgrade Stones from Challenger Rewards are now locked behind a progress wall. Same as grand items themselves.
-Challenges now can give more rewards based on the difficulty.
-Decreased Anniversary Event spawn chance by half.
-Decreased dragons' and champion bosses' health and defence.
-Npcs now disappear when the player crosses the starting line.
-Added an 'safe area' indicator under the shield that gets thrown by the first dragon.
-Added option for disabling Level up effect.
-Added option for hiding received damage numbers.
-Added option for showing only damage types.
-Reduced Outlaw's Deadeye passive skill's range.

[b]Fixes[/b]
-Fixed the problem where tier 9 skill relics didn't work for Outlaw.
-Fixed the problem where Outlaw's Tornado skill didn't work while basic attacking.
-Fixed the problem where grand items were not shown in inventory for Assassin and Outlaw.
-Fixed the problem where Outlaw's Barraboom relic didn't do damage.
-Fixed the problem where you were able to dodge while doing a target board portal activity.
-Fixed the problem where Mage's Eruption skill's area didn't get affected by relics.
-Fixed the problem where starting the portal activities with some classes was problematic.
-Fixed the problem where new item notification was not disappearing.
-Fixed the problem where Trader Portal Activity interaction was not showing interact button correctly.
-Fixed the legendary bounty portal activity.
-Fixed the problem where scatter dodge was not working for Ranger.
-Fixed the problem where scatter dodge arrows hit the player.
-Fixed the problem where Challenge Unlocks didn't work.
-Fixed the problem where you were able to select map mods on mini maps.
-Fixed the problem where Voksira did not spawn on its layout.
-Fixed the problem where Lore Scrolls spawned on the wrong maps.
-Fixed the chests on chest node of conquer.
-Fixed the problem where Trader Portal Activity didn't work properly.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.6.0.0 - Challenger Season Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/41477bbee4376a294c1b405dc32dcf55666cca4a.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Shades of Rayna Update 0.6.0.0 (07/04/2023)

[b]New Season Event: Challenger[/b]
This season's focus is challenger tokens. You get these tokens by completing challenges in maps on Conquer mode. Challenges spawn in the map with 40% chance. Each map you get offered 3 tier challenges. Difficulty and rewards increase with each tier.

You need to complete "Welcome Challenger" pursue quest to have access these challenges in maps.

You will appear on the leaderboards when you get your first tokens. 


[b]New Class: Outlaw[/b]
Outlaw is the 5th class of the game. It's a ranged class with dual pistols. Just like other classes, it has 10 active and 5 passive skills. You can check these skills on Outlaw's store page and also purchase it from there. A trailer video is coming soon.

Just like other paid classes, you can play Outlaw for free until the end of first dragon fight.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2368290/Shades_of_Rayna__Outlaw_Class/


[b]New NPC: Challenger[/b]
Challenger is a new npc to the game. Unlike other npc's, Challenger accompanies you in the base. But first you need to rescue him and bring him to the base. 

[b]Pursue Quest[/b]: This is a new type of quest system. Pursue quests have steps you need to follow. When you complete a step, you are given another step to complete. After the last quest, you get the big reward. In this case, you bring Challenger to the base.

[b]Challenges[/b]: Once Challenger comes to the base, you will have access to the challenges in maps. Challenge stone has 40% chance to appear in a conquer map. When you activate a challenge, it will appear on screen for you to follow. You can see it fail or success.
While you are doing challenges in maps, you also complete Challenger's own objectives about these challenges. You can get rewards for them.
There is also an upgrade part of challenges. You can unlock tier 2 and 3 challenges to appear, you can upgrade the gained token count and also you can upgrade challenge stone spawn chance.

[b]Map Completion[/b]: This is a new endgame feature. A set of objectives to complete on the long haul. There are also Lore Scrolls and specific Collectibles for each map to acquire. Each map has 5 lore scrolls and 5 collectibles. Lore Scrolls give some stories about the map itself or the area around the map. Collectibles are from the game's OG players and some are about the map itself. These Lore Scrolls and Collectibles appear one per map with a very low chance in a conquer map.

[b]Rewards[/b]: Challenger has it's own shop. Since The Challenger becomes available in the early-mid endgame, he will offer Tier 10 and Grand+ items and their crafting materials. He will also sell conquer nodes very soon.


[b]Map Reworks[/b]
Sharpleaf Forest and Distorted Land are reworked with this patch. 


[b]Set Items Overhaul[/b]
All set bonuses except Bombs Away are changed. This was done to achieve that set items can only be used until diff 12. So without obsidian+ items, you won't be relying on to set items.


[b]Classes[/b]
-Max movement speed value is reduced from 800 to 600 on grand boots.
-Defence stats are added to grand spellbook stat pool.
-Defence stats are added to grand belt base stat pool.
-Defence stats are added to grand belt skill stat pool.
-Health stats are added to grand knife base stat pool.
-Critic chance stats are added to grand knife base stat pool.
-Assassin's Barrage Wall spawns less knives.
-Assassin's Barrage skill's max barrage count is increased from 5 to 9.
-Ranger's Another One passive skill doesn't apply for Spread skill anymore.
-Warrior's Ancient Grounds damage is increased. it's now same with Earthbreaker.


[b]Changes and Fixes[/b]
-Enemies now roam around and can't be damaged when you go in through a portal.
-Player character now have sounds for dodging, attacking, skill using, getting damaged and dying.
-You can now select "Continuous" mode while standing inside of the chest in the base to get loot from it until the chest count is 0. Or you can change the mode to "One" to get one chest at a time.
-Sound is greatly improved.
-Shade effect of player character and npc's are changed.
-Npc conversation screen visual is changed and has sounds now.
-Sets with miscalculated damage outputs are fixed.
-Death animation of all classes is fixed.
-Ambient sound is added for Fisherman's Nest.
-Ambient sound is added for Atlis Desert.
-General color changed for Atlis Desert, Dragon Den, Howling Glacier.
-Miscalculated "Attack Speed" relics are fixed.
-"Fire Rate" text on relics are changed to "Attack Speed".
-Weapon and Armor Stone icons are changed.
-Changes made to Dragon Den layout.
-Legendary Bounty portals now register portal completion of conquer objectives.


[b]Enemies[/b]
-Centaurs now move around.
-There is new outline for enemies.
-Enemy health bar locations are adjusted for each enemy.
-Enemy area damage is increased.


[b]New Relics[/b]
Melee Protection T5: Receive 10% less damage from melee attacks, receive 10% more damage from ranged attacks.
Ranged Protection T5: Receive 10% less damage from ranged attacks, receive 10% more damage from melee attacks.
Melee Protection T10: Receive 20% less damage from melee attacks, receive 20% more damage from ranged attacks.
Ranged Protection T10: Receive 20% less damage from ranged attacks, receive 20% more damage from melee attacks.

Shades of Rayna Update 0.5.1.3 (12/16/2022)

[b]New Event: Chill Treats Winter Event[/b]
There is new winter themed event.

-New event specific quests to acquire new cosmetic items.

[b]New Feature: Salvager[/b]
Salvager is a unit in the base that can salvage your materials in bulk. You get one of the 3 or 2 rewards for a salvage randomly.

[b]New Stats For Grand Items[/b]
There are 42 new stats in Grand Item stat pool. These are:
-Life Steal stat for each skill of every class, except Warrior's Rage skill

-Basic attack has chance to create a damage area
-Dodges have chance to leave slow area behind

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.5.0.0 - Conqueror Season Event, Map Modifiers, Conquer Objectives
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/1f967432ce4fae1587607ad56897ed04878d9705.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Shades of Rayna Update 0.5.0.0 (08/12/2022)

[b]Conqueror Season Event[/b]
The event will be active until October 12th.
1st place of 3 leaderboards will earn a dlc code of their own choice, including the packs that is not released yet, for example Outlaw class. If 1 person would complete the season on 1st place for multiple leaderboards, they will get more than 1 code. [i][b]Leaderboards are only for seasonal characters.[/b][/i]

[b]Conquer Objective System[/b]
Conquer endgame mode now has a objective system, like an endgame quest line. There are total of 185 objectives. Every difficulty and every champion bosses have their own objective page. You complete these pages one by one. Each page has their own unlocks.

[b]Map Modifiers[/b]
You can now modify your maps on Conquer mode with Map Modifiers. There are 122 different modifier stats.
Modifiers have 5 tier. Lower tiers have 2 stats and 5th tier has 3 stats. You can use maximum of 5 modifiers for a single map. So, you can modify a single map with 15 different stats.
Map Modifiers can be dropped from any enemy.

[b]New Map and Enemies[/b]
There is a new map called Heartless Cliff. It has 2 main and 1 mini maps. It also has 5 new enemies. Every enemy has its own boss mode move. Like other new maps, Heartless Cliff is not on campaign and can only be reached in Conquer mode.

[b]Dragon Den Map Rework[/b]
Dragon Den map is reworked. It is now more compact and is filled with foliage and crystals.

[b]Changes and Fixes[/b]
-Improved enemy optimization.
-Npcs now spawn after the character is spawned.
-All Elite and All Veteran nodes now spawn more enemies.
-Keystone drop chance is incrased
-Crafting materials are now dropped more amount.
-Boss area on maps now has more enemies
-Centaur arrows now spread in a straight line.
-Fixed the problem where Shrouded Fields portal activity areas are empty.
-Fixed the problem where some campaign quests couldn't be completed after defeating the Witch.
-Fixed the problem where rewards could be duplicated on Survive conquer node.
-Fixed a problem where glacial, splash and aqublast slow time weren't applied correctly.
-RANGER: Fixed a problem where Raining Spread arrows could damage the player.
-RANGER: Fixed a problem where Raining Spread III set didn't apply the buff correctly.
-WARRIOR-ASSASSIN: Fixed a problem where Warrior's axe and Assassin's sword sometimes couldn't reach the target board on Luino's Sanctum maps.
-WARRIOR-ASSASSIN: Fixed a problem where Warrior or Assassin could keep throwing their weapon after the target board portal activity.
-MAGE: Fixed a problem where sometimes Eruption doesn't go off when Er-Eruption is active.
-MAGE: Fixed a problem where Tremor visual effect wasn't showing.
-ASSASSIN: Fixed a problem where Assassin had Warrior's T10 skill relics.
-ASSASSIN: Fixed a problem where Scorch goes through walls.
-ASSASSIN: Flash now goes to mouse location.

notes.title: A Story About Heartless Cliff (New Map)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/181cf0d128c9834c57a77ff0b50e74a004712aa4.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Hoyhga's Edge was the name of the place where the land meets the ocean for the people of Hoyhga. [b]Naer[/b] and [b]Veala[/b] would meet there and sit behind the Bridge Of Dare. They would be terrified and amazed at the same time by the huge rocks at the bottom.

Veala was from Hoyhga. People never knew where Naer was from but they knew that his love for Veala was unprecedented.

One day, travelling merchants came across the lovers at their usual place. They were not talking or laughing like they always do but they were silent and still. Two lovers were murdered and [b]Caurh[/b] was standing on top their bodies.

People of Hoyhga buried Naer and Veala on the same place they meet behind the bridge. Hoyhga's Edge is now called [b]Heartless Cliff[/b].

Caurh was never seen again after. They say a curse was cast upon him and he can't ever leave Heartless Cliff.


[i]** Heartless Cliff is the new map that's coming with the new season.[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.4.5 - Balance Overhaul, Free Class Trials, Big Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/6babd3e31b4fc18e44571d2ba8ad010d5a9b01d9.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Shades of Rayna Update 0.4.5 (06/01/2022)

[b]Free Class Trials[/b]
Class Trial feature is in the game. You can play any class until after the first dragon fight, even if you don't own that paid class. When you return the base after the first dragon, you can't progress more unless you have the paid class (Ranger is always free). This will give you enough time to decide whether you liked the class or not.

[b]Balance Overhaul[/b]
Whole game's balance has been adjusted. This has been done to remove circumstances where an unbalanced enemy oneshots you. Right now, if you can't farm a difficulty, it's not because of some enemies are totally overpowered but that difficulty is really difficult for your character and you need to upgrade more.

[b]Effects Of Skills[/b]
Before, active skills of classes were useless until the mid-late endgame. They were only usable if you really upgraded that skill or worn certain gear sets. Right now, skills are realiable from the start of the game. The game is not a 'basic attack' heavy anymore, it's skill heavy.

[b]Stat Changes - Grand Items Base Defences[/b]
Before, grand items (obsidian to exalted) did not give their base defence stats. After fixing this, I realized that Tier 1 to 10 items' stats were added multiple times. That's why when you equipped a grand item, your defence stat was shown as reduced. This is why it took relatively long to balance the game again, because the whole stat system was changed. Right now, if you open up your existing characters, you'll notice that some of the stats were reduced. Do not worry, they are the correct stats now and the game is balanced for those stats.

[b]'Last Farewell' Enemy Mechanic[/b]
Some enemies make an attack even after their death now. Couple of enemies have this feature for testing purposes. More enemies might have their Last Farewell in the future. I'll note them in patch notes if it happens.

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
-'Attack' stat influence on skills is increased.
-Player character defence multiplier is increased.
-Player character critic damage multiplier is decreased.
-Enemy defence multiplier is decreased.

[b]Ranger[/b]
-Base health is decreased from 100 to 80.
-Base movement speed is increased from 600 to 700.
-Base attack speed is increased from 1 to 1.1.
-Life steal value is decreased from 1% to 0.2%

[b]Warrior[/b]
-Base damage is increased from 5 to 8.
-Base critic damage is increased from 1 to 8.
-Rage effect is decreased from 25% to 15%.
-Attack speed cap is increased from 3.0 to 3.5.
-Life steal value is decreased from 2% to 1.5%.
-Thunder Call relic's damage is decreased by half.
-Throw cooldown is increased from 7 to 9.
-Slice cooldown is increased from 6 to 7.

[b]Mage[/b]
-Base damage is increased from 7 to 12.
-Base health is decreased from 125 to 90.
-Corruption skill now applies on mouse location.
-Life steal value is increased from 1% to 3%.
-Splash skill's area is increased from 250 to 400.
-Reduce It passive skill's effect is decreased from 1/3 to 1/4.

[b]Enemy[/b]
-Shade-Fire-Ice-Poison influenced enemies are added.
-Enemies with auras will deal their corresponding damage types.
-Skelis' raining sword damage is increased.
-Relenti, Tiskor and Lyner spawn less projectile when they're boss.
-Skelnos' AI behaviour is fixed (The problem where the sorcerer casts spells from great distance).
-Skelnos' and Krigo's lightning attack now has a indicator on landing location.
-When it's boss, Reaper's projectile damage is increased by half.

[b]Changes and Fixes[/b]
-Luino's Sanctum has more melee enemies than ranged enemies now.
-Shielded enemies don't spawn on campaign anymore.
-Big Foot's duration is decreased from 10 to 6.
-Wanted Gear Score for the event challenge is decreased from 9000 to 7000.
-Map Skill Looting option was not in effect. It works now.
-Fixed an issue where changing the stats while in a map (equipping a gear, upgrading an attribute etc) was causing cooldowns to reset.
-Fixed an issue where Mage's Splash skill was not dealing damage correctly.

In campaign, with each map damage,defence and health values of monsters scale up. This was the same in endgame. For example, Howling Glacier map was easier than any map on any difficulty because the values of the enemies in that map were lower. This is changed. Every map has the same values in endgame now. Campaign is still the same.

Other than that, enemy damage and defence scaling for each difficulty is changed. The scale rate is much lower now, so the difference between any difficulty and one above it won't be huge. Escpecially for higher difficulties.

Shades of Rayna Update 0.4 (05/10/2022)

[b]1st Anniversary Season Event[/b]
We are celebrating the first year anniversary of Shades Of Rayna with a season event. This season event has its own activity and its own currency which can be spent to acquire gear. The event will run for 2 months, ends on [b]July 10th[/b].
There is also an Event Pass like previous season events but this season doesn't have a support pack on sale and it doesn't have cosmetic items as rewards. All event pass rewards are the new activity's currency.

[b]Win Assassin Class[/b]
First 3 players who complete the event pass first will earn the key code of the upcoming class Assassin.
[b]Rules to participate and win:[/b]
-You need to play online. All challenges are need to be saved online.
-You need to share a screenshot of your event pass on event-pass-submission channel on discord. If someone shares before you, you lose your place.

Previous season, leaderboards system was tested with labyrinth points leaderboards. This season, there are 3 leaderboards: Labyrinth Points, Gear Score, Mayhem Layout Completion.
Gear Score is a new stat in the game and it's calculated with all of character stats: Damage, Health, Defence, Attributes, Gear Slot Upgrade Count etc.
All leaderboards can be seen both in game while playing and on main menu screen.

[b]-[/b]General loot drop chance is decreased.

Shades of Rayna Update 0.3 (03/28/2022)

[h3][b]Labyrinth Of The Chosen Endgame Game Mode[/b][/h3]

Labyrinth has many nodes, just like Conquer mode has and you are given 3 options of these nodes every time you clean a labyrinth room. Every enemy and every node gives labyrinth points. When the points reach a certain threshold you gain a labyrinth chest. If you complete the labyrinth, you open these chests at the end. If you die, you lose the progression.

Lab tokens only drops from these chests and they are the main source the upgrade the labyrint (more points per enemy, more tokens, spawn chance of your favorite node etc) or unlock new things for the labyrinth (new nodes, new difficulties, maximum node count etc).

Labyrinth has its own progression, seperate from the rest of the game. At the end of this progression, there is the Labyrinth boss: Mazzak.

Some elements of the labyrinth are currently not available but they will be available very soon. Mazzak is one of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/231a4f6d62a1e5b71a4c375584a03b3668e4198a.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]Labyrinth Season Event[/b][/h3]

There is a new season event and a new event pass. With this pass, there are 3 new types of cosmetics in the game: [b]Level Up Effect[/b], [b]Footprint Effect[/b] and [b]Headwear[/b].

This event pass also has a supporter pack, like Mayhem event. Supporter pack has 3 more cosmetic items but it doesn't give the items directly. You will be able to get those items if you complete certain threshold on Event Pass, like how battle passes work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/dbb4529e0897a139432eddf4d128aeb206e59779.png[/img]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1942220/Shades_Of_Rayna__Labyrinth_Event_Supporter_Pack/


[h3][b]New Map and Enemies[/b][/h3]

There is a new map called [b]Shrouded Fields[/b]. It comes with a 2 different layout and a mini version for some nodes on Conquer mode. The map has 5 different enemies with different attacks on boss modes.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1569820/view/3093413694294763948


[h3][b]New Main Menu[/b][/h3]

The game now has different main menu. Character selection screen has also changed and there are now [b]12 character slot[/b], instead of 8.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1569820/view/3087787366397519419


[h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3]
-Tier 2 and above upgrade stones now drop after certain map levels (15-30-45-60). It means that you can't drop Armor Stone 5 until map level 60.
-Damage that's being dealt over time, now shown every half a second, instead of every second. It deals half the damage every half a second, so 'damage per second' stats remain true.
-Some mobs in Fisherman's Nest didn't have projectile attacks when they were bosses. It's added.
-Thrixun and Voksira were not in the boss node pool for conquer mode. They are added.
-Item Exchange is now can be used while on campaign.
-Character deletion does not load the game again.
-Minor adjustments are made for loot drops.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2 - Mayhem Season Event, New Gear Tiers, New Difficulties
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/c1f66e0a166bdeef5e8c4cd38437bd78031e3837.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Shades of Rayna Update 0.2 (12/27/2021)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/80e4cc8e8496bb9c9b556044829c0dbb5493956c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/0476ffaab3cdf8b5d6a3d1f048eded54bdba5b86.jpg[/img]

[b]Mayhem Season Event (12.27-02.10)[/b]
There is a new event and new event pass called Mayhem Season Event. The event has 24 challenges. Some of these challenges can only be done with a newly created seasonal character.

The event has 15 + 3 rewards. Extra 3 rewards comes from Mayhem Season Event Supporter Pack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1848760/

[b]New Difficulties[/b]
There are 10 new difficulties that make the total 20 difficulties. These new difficulties are called Mayhem difficulties and you can enter Mayhem difficulties via a node that spawns in previous tier keystones or you can create a fully Mayhem layout via Mayhem Keystone.

Nodes in Mayhem layouts are random, which means is that the node next to Mayhem 1 node could be a Mayhem 10 node.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/95c86bd2c0ef778df3c7d9de0c65a974ebc4bcd9.jpg[/img]

[b]New Gear Tier[/b]
There are 5 new gear tier above tier 10 gear: Obsidian, Ancient, Mythical, Angelic and Exalted.

These gear have random modifiers and random stats.

You can learn more about it and check these modifiers via a spreadsheet in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1569820/view/3102414008267996105]link[/url].

[b]Crafting System[/b]
Crafting system is added to the game with 25 new crafting materials. Which means more and more loot!

With these materials you can craft:
Tier 1-4 gear,
Tier 5-9 gear,
Tier 10 gear (basic, unique, set),
Obsidian gear,
Ancient gear,
Mythical gear,
Angelic gear,
Exalted gear.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/956ff2076a6471e8a1c64dcb895c27e186ca5a1a.jpg[/img]

[b]New Map - New Mobs[/b]
Fisherman's Nest is in the game now with 2 different layouts and 1 mini version. It can be accessed via conquer end game mode. It has 5 new mobs and achievements for these mobs are added to the game.

[b]New Relics[/b]
4 new tier 10 relics are added to the game:

Damage Trinity I: +8 fire, ice, poison damage
Damage Trinity II: +8 doom, void, gloom damage
Resistance Trinity I: +8 fire, ice, poison resistance
Resistance Trinity II: +8 doom, void, gloom resistance

[b]Changes[/b]
-Tier 10 item drop rates are increased and difficulty level of T10 Set Items are also lowered.
-Adjustments have been made to mini version of maps.
-In town, the camera doesn't zoom in and out while a UI window is open anymore.
-Difficulty increase between difficulty levels is decreased.
-Shields of shielded mobs are decreased to 3/5 their max health. It was same with their health before.
-Health and defence of veteran, elite and boss mobs are decreased for ranger and mage.

notes.title: Create Your Item In Game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/a77080a1cc985785b7ab62b7389ed32781b7f8ae.jpg[/img]

You can use this [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OIuw4dlbGTdcYePjnkaSFQ_bLZzDkirkOefC9vVNPMU]spreadsheet[/url] to create items and share them on "item-creation" channel in [b]discord[/b].

[b]Ancient[/b] - 3 Base Stats + 1 Skill Stats
[b]Mythical[/b] - 3 Base Stats + 2 Skill Stats
[b]Angelic[/b] - 3 Base Stats + 2 Skill Stats + 1 Special Stat
[b]Exalted[/b] - 3 Base Stats + 2 Skill Stats + 2 Special Stats

You can also add [b]new special stats[/b], similar to what's already on.
You can also add [b]new skill stats[/b], as long as it follows [b]the pattern[/b]. For example, bow takes damage related stats.

These items will be special items and will always be in the game.

Example:

(Item Name) Ruler Of The Unbroken
💥 Damage
💥 Fire Rate
💥 Shade Damage
⚡ Spread Damage
⚡ Spread Attribute
⭐ Every hit gives +1% damage (%25 max) and it reset on damage taken
⭐ Bombs Away Set +2

notes.title: Mayhem Season Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/b16e22fde3854c373f12105ce33322a85f51b505.png[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


There will be [b]Mayhem Season Event[/b]. I'll announce the date soon. 

I don't want to make seasons like other arpgs, because this is not an online game. I like the concept of event like the mage event, I think this system is more suitable for this game.

The event will have challenges and rewards, just like mage event. These will be [b]free[/b]. But there will also be a premium pass of some sort. You can think this pass as a supporter pack. This pass will have a few extra cosmetic rewards and maybe experience boost and gold gain boost. It's not certain yet. [b]Premium Pass[/b] will be [b]$1.99[/b].

Rewards from this event will be [b]account bound[/b], not character bound. Also, this event will not be implemented to the game as a part of the endgame in the future.

Some of the [b]challenges[/b] will only be acquired with a [b]newly created character[/b]. Existing characters will not be able to complete all challenges.

I'm thinking the event will run for [b]6-8 weeks[/b].

Shades of Rayna Update 0.1 (10/26/2021)

[b]Mage Is Released![/b]

New class Mage is now released! You can check it at its own page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1797620

[b]Mage Release Event and Free Event Pass[/b]

There will be Mage Release Event with a free event pass. It will contain 12 challenges to get 15 rewards, 3 cosmetic rewards. Event will start tomorrow and run 3 weeks. After the event is completed, it will be added to main content later as a quest.

Preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/496d93b1037fbd85570230567563f36df6cc254e.png[/img]

[b]Campaign Progress Problem[/b]

After the last patch, when new dragons are added, there was a problem with the campaign progress. It's now fixed for new created characters.
If you have a character that has progress problem but managed to kill the last boss and reach the endgame, all your campaign progress now is set to completed.
If you still have problems regarding to this, after this update, please reach to me on discord and I'll fix your problem. Only way to fix this for everyone is to wipe campaign progress but I don't want to do that. If you don't want to deal with it, you can just create a new character and it'll be good to go. 
Sorry for this.

[b]Loot Drops[/b]

There was a problem with the loot drops. Such as, getting a high tier when you shouldn't be getting it or getting very less gear overall. This problem is fixed. If you feel your character is really powerless on bosses, you can farm lower levels and you should be getting good gear now. If you want to have proper experience from start, you can always create more characters.

[b]Changes and Fixes[/b]

-Newly added Sikhert, Sektir, Crita, Xanat, Hayay and Yanjan items' base stats were wrong. It's fixed.
-Red barrier on boss area in new layout of Verdant Backwoods map is fixed.
-Some tutorials were still active even though "skip tutorials" button is checked. If you see tutorials still active, please report to me and I'll fix.
-Npc spawns in Dragon Den map are now disabled, because of problems with quests for the map. They will be enabled again soon.
-In town, 'Skills' and 'Pets' are now closer to waypoint and 'Collections' is at the previous location of 'Pets'.
-Big Foot and Poison Dart map skills now deal less damage.
-2nd Dragon now spawns less projectiles.
-Skill Point icon is added to level up screen, instead of the text.
-Lootpods should give correct amount now.


Not: Different damage type for Mage's skills are inactive right now and will be activated shortly. Their relics do not work currently.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.48 - Major Optimization Change, Additional Map Layouts and More
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/8d1d348cf7ed914f0f9e382c7cba474a588ceaf9.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Shades of Rayna Update 0.0.48 (10.02.2021)

[b]Major Optimization Change[/b]
To make the game more optimized, bosses do not spawn projectiles anymore if there are more than 15 mobs in the map. This will greatly increase the performance of the game while you are playing.

[b]Additional Map Layouts[/b]
There is a new layout for each existing maps, total of 6 new map variations. This will be refreshing when grinding.

[b]New Dragons[/b]
4th and 5th dragons are now in the game. Their damage types are Doom-Void and Gloom-Shade respectively. With these dragons added to the game, there is only The Witch remaining to be added to story as a major boss. 

[b]Buffs/Debuffs Bar[/b]
You can now see all effects (buffs, debuffs, passive skills, taken power ups etc.) on you with their timer. Buffs have blue and debuffs have red colors. 
If you come across a buff/debuff that doesn't appear on the bar, please let me know, so I can fix it. I might forget couple of effects.

[b]Mailbox - Free Chest Effect[/b]
There is now a mailbox in the base. You can receive free items given by the game via this mailbox.
As a starter, Fireplace Chest Effect is now claimable in the game until [b]9th October[/b]. Be sure to pick it up by then.

[b]New UI Changes[/b]
Mobs now have a different health bar UI. Bosses, Elites and Veterans have their colored icons above their health bars.
Map bosses have double boss icons to be easily differed from other bosses.
Shielded enemies now have their shield bars under their health bars.

[b]New Structures In The Base[/b]
Other than Mailbox, there are new structures in the base. These are Dark Lands entry and Labyrinth Of The Chosen entry. These are endgame modes that will be available in the game soon.

[b]Changes and Fixes[/b]
-All power ups are now working properly.
-Skill power ups were only available for one selected skill. It now may come for either one of the skills.
-Poison Circle power up is buffed. [i]"Every shot with ([strike]10[/strike])[b]30[/b]% chance Poison Circle does not have cooldown"[/i]
-Dragon chest stopping mid air problem should be fixed.
-Dragon Den map's chest was on the ground and sideways. It now falls down from the sky like the rest.
-"Equip" button on customization menu did not appear. It's fixed.
-When showing relics and gear items, the list is now paged instead of scroll down. This will immensely speed up the equipping gear/relic.

Shades of Rayna Update 0.0.47 (09/13/2021)

[b]Collection[/b]
You can now see every item and relic in the game and see which one you have already or which one you want to get. Items in the collection screen gets highlighted once you collect that item. Even if you remove that item with upgrading or exchanging, the highlight would still stay, meaning that you already came across this item.

[b]*[/b]If there is any problem regarding to collection, for example highlighted item's highlight would go off, let me know and I'll fix it. This is a new feature and its construction spreads almost every part of the game. So, something might go wrong.

[b]Item Changes[/b]
[b]Sikhert[/b] (Bow): Basic attacks have ([strike]35[/strike])20% chance to deal double damage
[b]Sektir[/b] (Arrow): Basic attacks have ([strike]35[/strike])20% chance to create (4)2 damage areas
[b]Crita[/b] (Helmet): Grants ([strike]50[/strike])35% of critic chance as critic damage if critic chance is above 40%
[b]Xanat[/b] (Armor): Grants ([strike]20[/strike])14% of damage as defence
[b]Hayay[/b] (Gloves): Grants ([strike]15[/strike])10% more fire rate
[b]Janjan[/b] (Boots): Grants ([strike]20[/strike])10% of max health as movement speed

[b]New Unique Items[/b]
-4 New Sikhert items with higher percentages: [b]Sikhert II[/b], [b]Sikhert III[/b], [b]Sikhert IV[/b], [b]Sikhert V[/b]: 24%, 28%, 32%, 35%
-4 New Sektir items with higher percentages and higher number of areas:
[b]Sektir II[/b]:  24% chance, 2 areas
[b]Sektir III[/b]:  20% chance, 3 areas
[b]Sektir IV[/b]:  24% chance, 3 areas
[b]Sektir V[/b]:  20% chance, 4 areas
-4 New Xanat items with higher percentages: [b]Xanat II[/b], [b]Xanat III[/b], [b]Xanat IV[/b], [b]Xanat V[/b]: 17%, 20%, 24%, 28%
-4 New Janjan items with higher percentages: [b]Janjan II[/b], [b]Janjan III[/b], [b]Janjan IV[/b], [b]Janjan V[/b]: 14%, 18%, 22%, 25%

[b]*[/b]This unique items are for both Ranger and Warrior.

[b]Raining Spread Relic[/b]
This Tier 3 relic was raining 1 arrow, it now rains multiple arrows.

There are 3 new early game sets for ranger's Raining Spread relic.

notes.title: New Conquer Endgame Mode, New UI Styles, New Maps and More
notes.content:

Shades of Rayna Update 0.0.36 (07/20/2021)

[b]New Conquer Mode[/b]
Whole layout depends on the difficulty of first node. When you complete a layout, you will get a special reward (Upper difficulty keystones, random relics, gear, pet etc). A layout is completed when you clear the last node, at the bottom right corner. 
First node's difficulty is set by the keystones which will be used for creating a layout.
Nodes might be regular maps with certain difficulty, some smaller maps with different game modes which gives materials, relics, gear, pets as rewards, dragon maps, new Mayhem difficulty maps, chest maps.

[b]Your existing keystones are now resetted and there are 5 new keystones in the game.[/b]

[b]New Maps[/b]
There are 6 new maps which are the mini versions of 6 existing maps. Different play modes on layouts will be held in these maps.

[b]New Dragon Den Map[/b]
Dragon Den map is extended. Now it's like a regular map with mobs and portals. While you are playing the map, a dragon will fly over you -you see its shadow- to let you know that there will be a dragon fight when you complete the map. Dragon spawn chance is 25%.

[b]Damage Types and Resistances[/b]
There are 7 new damage type stats. 7 resistance stats are now in effect but there are no relics in the game currently that will buff your resistance and damage type stats. There will be Tier 10 attack and defence relics that will boost damage type and resistances very soon.

[b]Changes and Fixes[/b]
-Base gear defence stats are buffed after Tier 8 for Warrior.
-Extra Spread not dealing damage problem is fixed.
-Warrior interaction problems are fixed.
-Basic attack was not hitting the dragon when Fly Through was unlocked. It's fixed.
-Lootpods were not entirely getting destroyed when map boss is dead. It's fixed.
-You can't start target board portal activities when basic attack penalty is active anymore.
-Steal passive skill doesn't work on dead dragons anymore.
-You can now go back to character selection screen from the menu, instead of closing and reopening the game.
-Bombing Cut description was incomplete, it's fixed: Cutter arrows keep exploding without getting destroyed if 7 Bombing Cuts are equipped

[b]New UI Styles[/b]
Some UI elements have been changed to new styles. There will be more coming with every update.

There are now 6 resistance stats (Burn, Poison, Chill, Doom, Void, Shadow) and 1 immunity stat (Fear). Resistance stats are not in effect right now, they are just stats. This feature will be added soon. Fear immunity prevents you from getting feared. Ranger's default stat is 25, Warrior's 50.

[b]Item Changes[/b]
[b]Crita:[/b] Grants ([strike]100%[/strike]) 50% of Critic Chance as Critic Damage if Critic Chance Is Above 40%
[b]Xanat:[/b] Grants ([strike]25%[/strike]) 20% of Damage as Defence
[b]Hayay:[/b] Grants ([strike]25%[/strike]) 15% More Fire Rate
[b]Janjan:[/b] Grants ([strike]25%[/strike]) 20% of Max Health as Movement Speed

[b]Mineclock:[/b] Minespread Time Is Increased 150% ([strike]2+ Minespreads[/strike]) 
[b]Mineflow:[/b] Spread Damage Is Increased %200 if ([strike]3+[/strike]) 2+ Minespreads Are Equipped
[b]Minedeal:[/b] Spread's Cooldown Is Set to 1 if ([strike]4+[/strike]) 3+ Minespreads Are Equipped
[b]Minefield:[/b] Minespreads Explode Dealing 400% Area Damage if ([strike]5+[/strike]) 4+ Minespreads Are Equipped
[b]Minebomb:[/b] Spread Arrows Explode on Hit Dealing Area Damage if Extra Spread and ([strike]6+[/strike]) 5+ Minespreads Are Equipped
[b]Minemode:[/b] Minespread Applies the Other Skill's Status if ([strike]7[/strike]) 6+ Minespreads Are Equipped

[b]Exotime:[/b] Spread Time Is Increased 200% ([strike]2+[/strike]) if Extra Spread Is Equipped
[b]Exiheal:[/b] Spread Arrows Steal 0.5% Life if ([strike]3+[/strike]) 2+ Extra Spreads Are Equipped
[b]Exxxtra:[/b] Release 3 Spread Instead of 2 if ([strike]6+[/strike]) 5+ Extra Spreads Are Equipped
[b]Exespeedo:[/b] Spread's Damage Is Increased ([strike]500%[/strike]) 400% if (7) 6+ Extra Spreads Are Equipped


[b]Other Changes and Fixes[/b]

-Dropped loot spread is reduced.
-Mob projectiles do not push other mobs anymore.
-Defence power up which lets you blast nearby enemies on damage taken is buffed.
-"Skip All Tutorials" option is added. You can enable and disable this whenever you want on Options.
-You were able to upgrade pets beyond Tier 5. It's fixed. If you have pets above Tier 5, they are Tier 5 now.
-Damage areas which spawned by mobs now don't damage or slow you if you are dodging.
-Sudtir pet stat was starting from 5% instead of 10%. It's fixed.
-Janjan boots now have a unique border.
-Instant life leech and visual cooldown problems are now fixed.
-Cutter now stops on hit to any mob.
-Mobs were dodging Minespreads. It's fixed.
-Second dragon now drops potions.
-Kemgum was working for the second basic attack when it's not equipped. It's fixed.
-Basic attack was hitting a mob twice when fly through is active. It's fixed.
