notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.32 - Major Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/e62e6e7fb381c92a0a83f44f689e4f0a4ccd403c.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]


Shades of Rayna Update 0.0.32 (06/15/2021)

[b]New Dragon[/b]
Second dragon is added to the game. Since there are only two dragons in the game, first dragon will appear in 1st-3rd-5th dragon maps and the new dragon will appear in 2nd-4th dragon maps. Same thing happens in campaign too. Pet loot drops are same for both dragons.

[b]Material Buy/Sell[/b]
There is now a feature that lets you buy or sell materials. Buy and sell prices and material amoun are different for each material but buy-sell prices are same for the material. You can sell same amount of certain material for the same price that you bought it. You can access this feature in item exchange screen.

[b]T10 Item Exchange[/b]
You can now trade 3 Tier10 gear for a chance to get T10 Set item or T10 Unique item.

[b]New Free Pet[/b]
There is a new free pet called Sudtir. It boosts your critic damage. You don't have this pet immediately. When you drop this pet's loot, first drop will make you own it. Upgrading is the same with other pets.

[b]Item Lock For Exchange[/b]
You can now lock items that you don't want to go into the exchange.

[b]New Map Skills[/b]
Poison Dart: When activated, shoot 8 poisonous darts in front of your character
Healing Pot: When activated, heals 25% of your max health
Big Foot: When activated, your every step makes an explosion for 10 seconds

[b]New Relics[/b]
Critical Power (T7 Attack): +5 Critic Damage for every relic below Tier 9
Critical Luck (T7 Attack): +2 Critic Chance for every relic below Tier 9
Minespread (T10 Skill): As they travel, Spread arrows leave mines that deal Spread Damage (3 seconds)
Diverging Rain (T10 Skill): Rain Arrows release 4 arrows on hit dealing Rain Arrow damage
Bombing Cut (T10 Skill): Cutter arrows become targetable and explodes on certain hit count dealing area damage

[b]Changes and Fixes[/b]
-Unique and Set items now have borders to seperate them from regular items.
-Unique T10 items drop after Difficulty 3, Set T10 items drop after Difficulty 6.
-There is no restart button in conquer mode anymore. Conquer selection screen now appears when you die.
-Relic Spread Time now adds to Spread Time.
-Pet upgrade button has a cooldown of 0.5 seconds now to prevent multiple upgrading while fast clicking.
-More graphic settings are added.
-Cooldowns are now updated when you switch gear while in map.
-Multiple projectile skills like Spread or Cutter's projectiles now aligned to center.
-Item exchange and material buy/sell features are now available after the campaign and locked during it.
-When you slay the last dragon, now all maps will be 10/10. You can move directly to endgame.
-Empty fossil drop problem is fixed.
-Loot following player and not get autolooted problem is fixed.
-When you fail a target board portal activity but then complete another one in the same map would give rewards for both activity. It's fixed.
-You now can't dodge while doing target board activity.
-Dragon maps drop rates are decreased.
-T10 drop rates are decreased for Difficulty 8-9-10.
-Pet loot drop rate decreased slightly.
-Keystone drop rate is decreased.

[b]Skill Upgrade Change[/b]
Skill upgrade gives more to skill stats than regular attribute upgrades. For example, if a regular attribute upgrade would give 3, skill upgrade would give 6.5. It's still like this during the campaign. When you complete the campaign, your skill stats will decrease and have the same impact as the regular attribute upgrades. This is like this because of the new material buy/sell feature.

[b]Bows[/b]
Minetail (T10): Minespread deals 250% damage
Exspratt (T10): Spread's damage is increased 300% if Extra Spread is equipped
Diverhead (T10): Diverging Rain's damage is increased 300%
Bouncer (T10): Bouncing Fists' damage is increased 300%
Edgenebi (T10): Cutting Edge's damage is increased 300%
Cutabom (T10): Bombing Cut's damage is increased 250%
Sikhert (T5): Basic attacks have %35 chance to deal double damage

[b]Arrows[/b]
Mineclock (T10): Minespread time is increased 150% if 2+ Minespreads are equipped
Exotime (T10): Spread time is increased 200% if 2+ Extra Spreads are equipped
Divertort (T10): Diverging Rain arrows fly through enemies if Diverhead is equipped
Bouncy (T10): Rain Arrow's area is increased 200% if Bouncer is equipped
Edgekuro (T10): Cutting Edge arrows fly through enemies
Cutaton (T10): Bombing Cut's area is increased 200%
Sektir (T5): Basic attacks have 35% chance to create 4 damage areas

[b]Helmets[/b]
Mineflow (T10): Spread's damage is increased 200% if 3+ Minespreads are equipped
Exiheal (T10): Spread arrows steal 0.5% life if 3+ Extra Spreads are equipped
Divemereyo (T10): 20% more critic damage if Diverging Rain is equipped
Bounced (T10): 20% more critic chance if Bouncing Fists is equipped
Edgebic (T10): 20% more movement speed if Cutting Edge is equipped
Cubart (T10): Cutter cooldown is set to 1 but Cutter itself does not do damage
Crita (T5): Grants 100% of critic chance as critic damage if critic chance is above 40%

[b]Body Armors[/b]
Minedeal (T10): Spread's cooldown is set to 1 if 4+ Minespreads are equipped
Exobomb (T10): Spread arrows leave double mines if Extra Spread and Minespread are equipped
Diveded (T10): Rain Arrow's cooldown and rain time are set to 1.5
Bouncert (T10): Rain Arrow's rain time is increased 300%
Edgego (T10): Cutter's damage is increased 400% if 3+ Cutting Edges are equipped
Cubbacota (T10): 20% more fire rate if Bombing Cut is equipped
Xanat (T5): Grants 25% of damage as defence

[b]Gloves[/b]
Minefield (T10): Minespreads explode dealing 400% area damage if 5+ Minespreads are equipped
Exudu (T10): Spread arrows have 25% chance to deal double damage if Extra Spread is equipped
Divermay (T10): Rain Arrow's area is increased 200% if 4+ Diverging Rains are equipped
Bouncel (T10): Bouncing Fists' area is increased 200% if 4+ Bouncing Fists' are equipped
Edgekami (T10): Cutter time is increased 300%
Cobicut (T10): Cutter's damage is increased 300% if 4+ Bombing Cuts are equipped
Hayay (T5): Grants 25% more fire rate

[b]Pants[/b]
Minebomb (T10): Spread arrows explode on hit dealing area damage if Extra Spread and 6+ Minespreads are equipped
Exxxtra (T10): Release 3 Spread instead of 2 if 6+ Extra Spreads are equipped
Divertah (T10): Rain Arrow releases 8 Diverging Rain arrow instead of 5 if 6+ Diverging Rains are equipped
Bouncor (T10): Rain Arrow releases 4 Bouncing Fists' instead of 2 if 6+ Bouncing Fists are equipped
Edgemer (T10): Cutter arrows spread more Cutting Edge arrows if 6+ Cutting Edges are equipped
Combco (T10): Max Cutter arrow number becomes 8 if 6+ Bombing Cuts are equipped
Lemuh (T5): Dodges have 35% chance to leave chill area behind

[b]Boots[/b]
Minemode (T10): Minespread applies the other skill's status if 7 Minespreads are equipped

Divertuyo (T10): Rain Arrow's damage is increased 400% if 7 Diverging Rains are equipped
Bouncem (T10): Rain Arrow's damage is increased 400% if 7 Bouncing Fists' are equipped
Edgeker (T10): Cutting Edge's size is increased 150% if 7 Cutting Edges are equipped
Cotmami (T10): Cutter arrows keep exploding without getting destroyed
Janjan (T5): Grants 25% of max health as movement speed

notes.title: Relics Explained
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/e511c997b24e9b9b5555e1f5929ad76ec777c0ea.jpg[/img]


[url=https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj]You can join Discord server here.[/url]



Hey there, i wanted to explain the basics of Relic system in Shades of Rayna, which plays a big part in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/72d7ab542d58b68b530f18465b1514af635e0687.png[/img]

You have 7 gear slot in the game: Bow-Arrow-Helmet-Armor-Gloves-Legs-Boots (Weapon part of slots will change for each class). Each of these gear slots have Upgrade part and 3 relic slots: Red is Attack, Blue is Defence and Yellow is Skill. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/dde886d12bb1d0e1c2ac43c150fed02b91d1835e.png[/img]

You put relics to these slots to boost your character. Just like weapon and armors, relics also have tiers. Higher the tier, better the boost.

As you can see in the picture above, we have basic attack and defence boost and a skill relic that boosts Raining Arrow skill's damage. As you progress in the game, you will get much more powerfull relics that give 2 or 3 attributes at the same time. For example, a relic that boost Raining Arrow skill's damage, raining time and decreases its cooldown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063979/fa9f6165425eb255d9dd963d8feb0d2382b212fd.jpg[/img]

[i]"Cutting Edge: Cutter releases spreading arrows as it rolls"[/i]

There are special relics as well. For example the relic above is changing Cutter skill.

Base Skill: https://gph.is/g/4AO8NOV
Upgraded Version: https://gph.is/g/E0D8N8o


There are many special relics in the game. Some change the skill more, some less. You will combine them to create your own version of skills and your own builds.


[i]For example: [/i]

Base Skill: Raining Arrow
Special Relic 1: Raining Arrows become fire arrows
Special Relic 2: Raining Arrows create fire areas on hit
Special Relic 3: Raining Arrows will scatter on hit


After the 3rd upgrade you will be a walking chaos. After that, if you can get an upgrade which affects the scatter arrows.... WTF?!


These kind of relics will be added more and more if the playerbase wants it, as the game progresses. When you play the game if you get any kind of upgrade idea, feel free to let me know and I will seriously consider adding player ideas to the game. Join us on discord to share them!


[i]-Gökay[/i]
